## Convx 2.1.5

### Download
- **`convx-2.1.5.apk`**: one APK for every 64-bit ARM phone.

### New
- **Reorder playlists.** Open one of your playlists and tap **Edit**: drag the handles to change the order, or tap the red button to remove a song. Tap **Done** when you're finished. Changes to your own YouTube playlists are saved to YouTube too.

### Fixes
- Your YouTube playlists, albums and artists show up in Library again after signing in. The redesigned Library never asked YouTube for them, so it stayed empty. Convx now syncs when it starts, when you open Playlists, Albums or Artists, and when you pull down to refresh those pages.
- A sync that failed no longer blocks the next one for 30 minutes.
